text: Been on hold then told to text so here goes. Foster daughter, 17 months. She just won't settle tonight, keeps standing up in the cot and grizzling, but she's eating, playing, her normal self otherwise. Her cheeks went bright red after we were out at the park in that freezing wind this afternoon, it's the same as she gets every time it's cold and blustery, warm bath and it was already fading. Colour otherwise is fine, lips normal. I need to log the call for the agency more than anything, but any tips for getting her down would be appreciated, it's nearly midnight
